title: TransRetrieval: Scaling Up Transformer-Based Retrieval for Industrial Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying scaling laws to recommendation retrieval is hindered by feature heterogeneity: naively stacking Transformer layers yields diminishing returns because heterogeneous fields produce severe token-norm divergence. We present TransRetrieval, a Transformer-based retrieval framework that scales with both computational budget and cross-domain data. The key enabler is (1) weighted average aggregation, which restores the homogeneous-token assumption Transformers rely on. Building on this, we introduce (2) target token compression that cuts per-candidate FLOPs by 85% while preserving cross-attention expressiveness, and (3) position-style domain embeddings that unify multiple domains at negligible additional cost, turning cross-domain data into a scaling asset. On a 40-billion-interaction industrial dataset and the public KuaiRand benchmark, scaling compute from 0.1 to 2 MFLOPs per target yields +19.3/+22.2 pt Recall@2000, confirming robust

translated_title: TransRetrieval：扩展基于Transformer的工业推荐检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25528v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将扩展定律应用于推荐检索受到特征异质性的阻碍：简单堆叠Transformer层会导致收益递减，因为异构字段会产生严重的token范数发散。我们提出了TransRetrieval，一种基于Transformer的检索框架，能够随计算预算和跨领域数据扩展。关键使能因素是(1)加权平均聚合，它恢复了Transformer所依赖的同质token假设。在此基础上，我们引入了(2)目标token压缩，将每个候选的FLOPs减少85%，同时保持交叉注意力的表达能力，以及(3)位置风格领域嵌入，以可忽略的额外成本统一多个领域，将跨领域数据转化为扩展资产。在40亿交互的工业数据集和公开的KuaiRand基准上，将每个目标的计算量从0.1扩展到2 MFLOPs，Recall@2000提高了+19.3/+22.2个百分点，证实了其稳健性。
tldr: 本文提出TransRetrieval框架，通过加权平均聚合、目标token压缩和领域嵌入技术，解决了特征异质性导致的扩展收益递减问题，实现了计算和跨领域数据的有效扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TransRetrieval, a framework that addresses diminishing returns from feature heterogeneity via weighted average aggregation, target token compression, and domain embeddings, enabling effective scaling with compute and cross-domain data.
